item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine with cool mornings over Guangdong in the next couple of days. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China gradually towards the weekend and early next week. Temperatures will rise over the region. It will become humid and foggy. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong midweek next week.
